title: ze_IMPERIUM
description:
ze_IMPERIUM 
Set in the grim dark future of the 41st millennium, fight your way through the sewers and under city, reaching the heavens to fight off Chaos

You are the worst humans, leaving the underground hive city
A chaos plague has appeared, turning fellow friends into zombies and ghouls
You leave your disgusting hole of a cave to find answers, up above...

 How to play 
This is a ZOMBIE ESCAPE map, it can only be played on a ZE server.
This map contains 1 unique long level, good luck for beating it! 

Map by Raphi and Hichatu

 Made for the S2ZE 2025 Return To Roots Mapping Contest
